decisions.rationale: The 2025 NOA (total income $100,310.80), employment letter base salary $97,620.22 and annualized pay stub (about $97,392) all support the stated $97,500.
The $92,300.93 seasoned balance covers the $57,500 down payment and closing costs, and the one large $10,870 deposit is explained by the matching vehicle bill of sale.
Cardinal Evaluation Services is on the panel, the report dated 2026-10-03 is recent, and the $578,000 value supports the $575,000 price with no outstanding conditions.
A recent (17 Oct 2026) signed letter on letterhead confirms permanent full-time employment since 2018 consistent with the application.
GDS is about 31.7% and TDS about 35.6% with liabilities matching the bureau, and credit score 751 meets DTI-02.
